title: nan
authors: Walczak J.; Szykuła B.; Targowski P.; Pałys T.
key_contribution: Presents a data fusion navigation system integrating downward-facing optical flow vision with IMU dead reckoning to reduce cumulative position drift for UAVs in GPS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
